# Focus

> Focus is a macOS 26 focus app written in Swift with SwiftPM. It watches the frontmost app and the current browser tab, uses the built-in camera (Vision face and head pose, and an RF-DETR phone detector in Core ML) and the iPhone's Bluetooth advertisement to detect drift, asks for typed check-ins, categorises every second, and rewards focused sessions with XP, 100 levels and a SceneKit-rendered garden. Everything runs on-device.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, use and build.
- [Design](docs/design.md): behaviour, every threshold, architecture and the session budget.
- [Research](research/README.md): the research notes behind the design.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): how to propose and submit changes.

- [Sources/Focus](Sources/Focus): the app, sensors, UI and garden renderer.
